## Bus Passenger Headphone Usage


```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))

logged_data <- read_csv("https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vQO9Qyksn-4DfN26YpXyWU9sMD85FLfrzqN719NOhOG--6z0lEIFXDW2Hn6nBK9C1Tm872wGr99_BQk/pub?output=csv")

latest_data <- logged_data %>%
  rename(
    timestamp = Timestamp,
    headphones = `Is the passenger wearing headphones?`,
    activity = `What is the passenger doing?`,
    minutes = `How many minutes have they been on the bus (estimated)?`,
    time_of_day = `Time of day`
  )
```

```{r}
prop_headphones <- mean(latest_data$headphones == "Yes")
mean_minutes <- mean(latest_data$minutes)
```

Approximately `r round(prop_headphones * 100, 1)`% of observed passengers were wearing headphones.

On average, observed passengers had been on the bus for `r round(mean_minutes, 1)` minutes.

```{r}
ggplot(latest_data, aes(x = headphones)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Headphone use among observed bus passengers",
    x = "Wearing headphones",
    y = "Count")
```

```{r}
ggplot(latest_data, aes(x = activity)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Activities of observed bus passengers",
    x = "Passenger activity",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
